integration.note: AGENTS.md authoritative; injected origin/harness-auto was for the launch repo ms-process-api, not this frontend repo. origin(GitHub) has no develop/harness-auto.

goal: Frontend (ms_process_app): per-country Descargar Excel button (valores actuales vs template) + import flow that POSTs the xlsx and renders diff+errors in ReviewPublishDialog, blocking publish on errors, reusing the existing per-table publish.

contract.export: GET /api/v1/params/{pais}/export.xlsx?template=true|false -> xlsx blob, Content-Disposition filename params_{pais}.xlsx / params_{pais}_template.xlsx
contract.import: POST /api/v1/params/{pais}/import (multipart field 'file') -> 200 {country, valid, tables:[{table, rows, diff:{row_count_before,row_count_after,added,removed,added_count,removed_count}, errors:[str], warnings:[str]}]}; 400 {error,message} on bad file

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Download control with mode toggle (valores actuales / template vacio) calls export.xlsx (template=true only for template) as a blob and triggers a file download with the contract filename.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: downloadParamsExcel(country, template) GETs /params/{country}/export.xlsx with responseType blob and params {template:true} only when template; anchor click + revokeObjectURL. e2e: download event suggestedFilename matches /^params_CL(_template)?\.xlsx$/.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Import uploads the xlsx (multipart), maps the backend ImportResult to issues+diff, renders them in ReviewPublishDialog, and blocks publish when any table has errors.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: mapImportResult unit test (errors->error issues, warnings->warning issues, added/removed rows->DiffEntry). Component test: importParamsExcel resolves clean result -> dialog shows diff-table and confirm-publish enabled; resolves result with errors -> dialog-error-badge shown and confirm-publish disabled.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Playwright @smoke walkthrough: descargar -> (mock) subir xlsx -> ver diff -> publicar, against the mock-server.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: MOCK_SERVER_PORT=8000 npm run test:e2e:fast -- -g 'Excel' passes the new @smoke test: download event fires, import opens review-dialog with diff-row, confirm-publish hits POST /params/.../publish 200 and a success toast appears.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm test + lint + tsc + build all green.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b && npm run build
